headline: Bitcoin is steady near $80,500 early Monday in Asia as Gulf tensions keep oil high, CoinDCX confirms a $16M loss, and markets brace for a packed Fed week.

market.asOf: Prices read from CoinMarketCap's homepage at about 20:00 UTC Sun 25 Oct (03:00 Mon Bangkok); Alternative.me showed BTC at $80,686 at the same time. The 24h change could not be confirmed this run. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 54 (Neutral) on Alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0-100), read about 20:00 UTC; CoinMarketCap's own Fear and Greed Index read 45 (Neutral)

stories.title: Bitcoin steady near $80,500 as Gulf attacks keep oil near $117
stories.summary: Bitcoin has climbed back above $80,000 after Saturday's dip to its lowest level in more than a month. President Trump said there would be no US strike on Iran today, but missile attacks on Saudi Arabia continue and oil is very high. High oil can push inflation up, which makes the Fed less likely to cut rates.
points: Liquidations (traders forced out of borrowed bets) over 24 hours: more than $810M per Coinglass data cited by Investing.com; crypto.news gives about $546.88M.
Trump: "The answer is no, there will not be a strike today," per Gulf News. About 10 ballistic missiles were intercepted over southern Saudi Arabia and falling debris injured two people.
Brent oil settled Friday at $116.72, up 3.14%, its highest since 29 April; oil futures reopen Sunday 6pm ET (22:00 UTC), per FinanceFeeds.
The US State Department ordered non-emergency staff to leave its missions in Saudi Arabia, per FinanceFeeds.

sources.label: Investing.com: Bitcoin recovers to $80,800 ahead of Fed meeting
Gulf News: Missiles intercepted over Saudi Arabia
FinanceFeeds: Brent at $116.72 ahead of Sunday open

stories.title: CoinDCX confirms $16M loss after its CEO called breach reports a "false alarm"
stories.summary: Indian exchange CoinDCX now confirms it lost 15.99 million USDT (about $16M) from deposit wallets it had stopped using, days after its CEO dismissed the reports. It says it covered the loss. Other weekend security problems are still open: the Initia blockchain is still halted and hardware-wallet maker Keystone is facing more questions over leaked customer data.
points: CoinDCX lost 15.99M USDT from retired deposit wallets, per The Block.
Tether froze nine wallets holding 2,212,850 USDT; the funds came from 40 wallets on the TRON network, per The Crypto Times.
Initia said on 24 Oct its network and rollups remain halted after its exploit; its USDC bridge reserve briefly fell from about $1M to $63 on 23 Oct, per CryptoSlate.
Keystone customers say the leak included data the company had promised to delete; Keystone says private keys and recovery phrases were not exposed, per The Block.
If your address leaked, expect fake refund or replacement offers. Never type a recovery phrase into a website or reply.

sources.label: The Crypto Times: CoinDCX admits sweep failure
CryptoSlate: Initia bridge reserve down to $63
The Block: Keystone customers say deleted data leaked

stories.title: Fed week: rate decision Wednesday, inflation data Thursday, $11B bitcoin options expiry Friday
stories.summary: The Fed announces its rate decision on Wednesday, with a hold widely expected. Inflation (PCE) and growth (GDP) data land Thursday, along with Coinbase and Strategy earnings. About $11B of bitcoin options expire on Friday morning.
points: Fed range is 3.75-4.00%; 94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll expect a hold, per CoinAlertNews.
Spot bitcoin ETFs (funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors) had outflows of $635.5M on 22 Oct and $137.9M on 23 Oct, per crypto.news.
Even so, the week ended with about $301.2M of net inflows, per crypto.news citing Farside.
Deribit bitcoin options worth about $11B expire on Fri 30 Oct at 08:00 UTC (15:00 Bangkok), per EthNews and Crypto Briefing.

sources.label: CoinAlertNews: Fed to hold in October, hike in December

briefs.title: Brazil runoff: counting under way, no winner yet
briefs.summary: Polls closed at 4pm ET (03:00 Mon Bangkok). With only about 0.25% of polling stations counted at about 20:10 UTC, no winner had been declared. Final polls were split: Quaest had Flávio Bolsonaro 51%, Lula 49%, while Vox Brasil had the reverse, per The Rio Times.

briefs.title: US bank regulator finalizes first stablecoin rules under the GENIUS Act
briefs.summary: The OCC finalized the rules on 21 Oct, effective 18 Jan 2027, covering reserves, redemptions and custody, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Strategy adds 267 BTC and raises a repurchase limit
briefs.summary: Strategy now holds 848,517 BTC and lifted its repurchase authorization for its digital credit securities from $2B to $3B, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test on the Hoodi testnet
briefs.summary: The upgrade test, set for 26 Oct, is postponed while developers look into contract risks; no new date yet, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Week's movers: Zcash and Pepe up, Aave and Hedera down
briefs.summary: Over 7 days, Zcash rose 7.51% ahead of its NU7 upgrade around 5 Nov and Pepe 14.15%; Aave fell 11.65% and Hedera 13.47%, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Tether signs 15 bitcoin mining firms to its open-source mining kit
briefs.summary: 15 mining companies and industry groups have signed on, including Bitmain, MicroBT, Canaan, Foundry and F2Pool; version 1.0 is targeted before the end of 2026, per crypto.news.
